children: on Thursday announced the appointment of Jeffrey Kilborn as chief financial officer, bringing extensive capital markets experience supporting public company reporting, governance, and investor communication.

In his role as CFO, Kilborn will oversee financial reporting and serve as the company's primary interface with capital markets as 01 Quantum advances commercialization of its post-quantum cryptography technologies, the company said.
He was most recently the CFO & VP Corporate Development at Atlas Salt
), which raised over $25 million of capital during his tenure.
